grammarFocus: 让步与对比；关系从句；举例表达的多种形式。
title: The Slow Train to Lijiang: A Journey Through Time and Culture
instructions: 阅读下面的文章，回答10个问题。文章为模拟材料，非真实事件。题目类型包括单选、填空、判断正误/未提及。请根据文章内容作答，填空答案必须与原文完全一致。
passage:
A. When my friend Chen Wei suggested taking the slow train from Kunming to Lijiang instead of the fast one, I was doubtful. The fast train takes only three hours, while the slow train takes nine. 'But the slow train stops at every small station,' Chen Wei said. 'You see the real Yunnan.' Although I usually prefer efficiency, I agreed to try something different.

B. We boarded the train early in the morning. The carriage was old but clean, with wooden seats and large windows. Most passengers were local people: farmers carrying baskets of vegetables, students going home, and elderly women in traditional dress. A young man sitting opposite us offered us some sunflower seeds. 'For the journey,' he said with a smile. Even though we had brought our own snacks, we accepted his gift. This small act of kindness made me feel welcome.

C. As the train climbed into the mountains, the scenery changed dramatically. We passed terraced fields that looked like giant steps, small villages with grey tiled roofs, and deep valleys where rivers rushed over rocks. At one station, a group of children waved at the train. Chen Wei explained that in some villages, the train is the only reliable transport, especially during the rainy season when roads become muddy. The slow train, which many city people consider outdated, is actually a lifeline for these communities.

D. Around noon, we bought lunch from a vendor who walked through the carriage selling rice noodles and tea eggs. The noodles were simple but delicious, and they cost only ten yuan. While we were eating, an old man next to us started telling stories about the old days. He had worked on the railway for forty years. 'In the past, the journey took two days by bus,' he said. 'Now young people complain about nine hours!' We all laughed. Despite the language barrier, I felt connected to these people through shared laughter.

E. The train made many stops, and at each one, passengers got on and off. Some stations were just small platforms with no buildings. At one stop, a woman boarded with a live chicken in a basket. The chicken clucked loudly, which made everyone smile. Although the journey was long, I never felt bored. There was always something to watch or someone to talk to.

F. As the afternoon passed, the landscape became more dramatic. We crossed a high bridge over a deep gorge, and later passed a lake so blue it seemed unreal. Chen Wei told me that this area is home to several ethnic minority groups, each with its own language and customs. For example, the Naxi people, who live near Lijiang, have a unique writing system that uses pictographs. I realized that the slow train was not just a means of transport; it was a window into the culture and history of the region.

G. We arrived in Lijiang just as the sun was setting. The old town, with its cobbled streets and wooden houses, looked like something from a storybook. Although I was tired, I felt grateful for the experience. The slow train had taught me that sometimes the journey is more important than the destination. It had also shown me that despite our different backgrounds, people share a common humanity. As we walked to our guesthouse, I knew this would be a trip I would never forget.

questions.prompt: Why did Chen Wei suggest taking the slow train?
options: Because it is faster than the fast train.
Because it stops at every small station, allowing passengers to see the real Yunnan.
Because it is cheaper than the fast train.
Because the fast train was not available.
answers: Because it stops at every small station, allowing passengers to see the real Yunnan.
questions.explanation: 文章第一段Chen Wei说“But the slow train stops at every small station... You see the real Yunnan.”，因此选B。
questions.evidence: But the slow train stops at every small station,' Chen Wei said. 'You see the real Yunnan.'

questions.prompt: What did the young man opposite the author offer?
questions.explanation: 第二段提到“A young man sitting opposite us offered us some sunflower seeds.”，因此选C。
questions.evidence: A young man sitting opposite us offered us some sunflower seeds.

questions.prompt: The lunch (rice noodles and tea eggs) cost only ______ yuan.
questions.explanation: 第四段说“they cost only ten yuan”，因此填ten。
questions.evidence: The noodles were simple but delicious, and they cost only ten yuan.

questions.prompt: According to the passage, why is the slow train important for some villages?
options: It is the only reliable transport, especially during the rainy season.
It provides free food for passengers.
It offers jobs to local people.
answers: It is the only reliable transport, especially during the rainy season.
questions.explanation: 第三段说“the train is the only reliable transport, especially during the rainy season when roads become muddy.”，因此选A。
questions.evidence: the train is the only reliable transport, especially during the rainy season when roads become muddy.

questions.prompt: What is the Naxi people's writing system like?
questions.explanation: 第六段提到“the Naxi people... have a unique writing system that uses pictographs.”，因此选B。
questions.evidence: the Naxi people, who live near Lijiang, have a unique writing system that uses pictographs.

questions.prompt: How long did the old man say the journey took by bus in the past?
questions.explanation: 第四段老人说“In the past, the journey took two days by bus”，因此选C。
questions.evidence: In the past, the journey took two days by bus,' he said.

questions.prompt: What did the woman at one stop bring onto the train?
options: A live chicken in a basket.
answers: A live chicken in a basket.
questions.explanation: 第五段说“a woman boarded with a live chicken in a basket.”，因此选A。
questions.evidence: At one stop, a woman boarded with a live chicken in a basket.

questions.prompt: How did the author feel about the journey?
options: Bored because it was too long.
Tired but grateful for the experience.
Angry because the train was late.
answers: Tired but grateful for the experience.
questions.explanation: 最后一段说“Although I was tired, I felt grateful for the experience.”，因此选B。
questions.evidence: Although I was tired, I felt grateful for the experience.

questions.prompt: The author's friend Chen Wei is a local person from Lijiang.
questions.explanation: 文章没有明确说明Chen Wei是否是丽江本地人，只提到他是作者的朋友并建议坐慢车，因此是Not Given。
questions.evidence: 文中未提及Chen Wei的籍贯。

questions.prompt: The author spoke the local language fluently.
questions.explanation: 第四段提到“Despite the language barrier, I felt connected to these people through shared laughter.”，说明作者有语言障碍，因此是False。
questions.evidence: Despite the language barrier, I felt connected to these people through shared laughter.

grammar.title: 让步与对比；关系从句；举例表达
grammar.explanation: 让步用although/even though/despite等表示‘虽然’；对比用while/whereas表示‘而’；关系从句用who/which/that连接句子；举例用for example/such as/like等。
grammar.example: Although I usually prefer efficiency, I agreed to try something different.

questions.prompt: ______ it was raining heavily, we decided to go for a walk.
questions.explanation: 句子表示让步‘虽然下雨，我们还是去散步’，用Although。
questions.evidence: Although I usually prefer efficiency, I agreed to try something different.

questions.prompt: The book ______ I borrowed from the library is very interesting.
questions.explanation: 先行词是book（物），关系代词用which。
questions.evidence: the train, which many city people consider outdated

questions.prompt: Many fruits, ______ apples and oranges, are rich in vitamin C.
questions.explanation: 表示举例，such as后接名词列举。
questions.evidence: For example, the Naxi people, who live near Lijiang, have a unique writing system that uses pictographs.

questions.prompt: ______ the high price, the restaurant is always crowded.
questions.explanation: Despite后接名词短语表示让步。
questions.evidence: Despite the language barrier, I felt connected to these people through shared laughter.
